text:
Once upon a time, there was a big, red umbrella. It was a very nice umbrella. One day, the sun came out and it was very hot. The sun was so hot that the umbrella began to feel dry.
The umbrella saw a little boy named Tim. Tim was very sorry because he was outside all day too. He was too hot and wanted to feel better. He had an idea. Tim decided to ask his mom for help.
Tim's mom got a wet umbrella. She told Tim to enter the house. Tim entered the house and they both sat under the umbrella. The rain came and washed the umbrella to make it just right. Tim was not sorry anymore. The umbrella was happy to help Tim and his mom. They all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Spot. Spot had an owner named Tim. Tim was very good at helping Spot. One day, they went to the park to play. Spot was very happy.
At the park, a little girl named Sue came to watch. Sue wanted to play with Spot. She said, "Spot, let's play!" But Spot did not want to play. He said, "No, I refuse to play." Sue was sad and asked again, "Please Spot, I want to play with you." But Spot still refused.
Sue had an idea. She found a big stick and gave it to Spot. Spot loved sticks! He forgot about the ball and ran to Sue with the stick. Sue and Spot played the game all day. They had so much fun. In the end, Spot was happy, and Sue was happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play hide and seek with her friends. One day, they played near a big tree near the water.
"Let's play hide and seek," said Lily. "I will count and you all hide!" Her friends ran to find hiding spots. Lily counted and waited for her friends to come and find her.
After a while, Lily's friends found her behind the tree. "I found you!" they said. Lily laughed and said, "Now it's my turn to count!" They all enjoyed playing hide and seek by the water, laughing and having fun together.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was an adorable little bunny. The bunny loved to hop and play with his friends. One day, the bunny saw a fun picnic with lots of yummy food.
The bunny wanted to eat the picnic, but he had to ask his mom first. The bunny ran to his mom and asked, "Mom, can I eat the picnic?" His mom smiled and said, "Yes, you can eat the yummy food."
The little bunny was very happy. He ate the food and it was very yummy. After eating, the bunny went back to play with his friends. They all had a great time at the picnic, and the adorable little bunny loved it.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty bracelet. The bracelet was pink and shiny. Lily loved her bracelet very much.
One day, Lily went to the park. It was a sunny day. She saw a big tree with delicious apples on it. Lily wanted to pick the apples, but they were too high. She tried to jump, but she could not reach them.
Lily had an idea. She found a long stick and used it to get the apples. She managed to pick many apples and put them in her bag. Lily was happy and went home to share the delicious apples with her family.

Once upon a time, there was a big onion. The onion lived in a garden with many other onions. The onion was very happy and loved to play with his friends.
One day, it started to rain. The rain made the garden very wet. The wet on the onion soaked up all the water. The onion was scared that his friends would get wet too.
The next day, the sun came out and the rain stopped. The onions were dry again. The onion was happy and went to play with his friends. They were all safe and dry, and they played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was an obedient girl who always listened to her mom and dad. One day, her mom asked her to go to the toilet. Lily went to the bathroom and saw a big bottle. She wanted to fill it with something nice.
Lily saw a jar on the top shelf of the bathroom. She thought the jar would look nice in the cup. She carefully picked up the jar and put it in the toilet. She was very happy that she could now fill the cup with her nice things.
After she put everything in the cup, Lily went back to her mom. Her mom was proud of her obedient and took the cup out of the toilet. Lily felt good that she helped her mom and learned that being obedient can help bring nice things to their home.

Once upon a time, there was a polite bunny named Ben. Ben loved to hop all day long. One day, he hopped so fast that he fell down. He rolled and rolled until he was far away from his home.
Ben looked around and saw a big tree. He hopped closer to the tree and saw a little bird. The bird was sad because it lost its way home. Ben wanted to help the bird, so he asked, "What does your home look like?"
The bird said, "It is a small hole in a tree, but it is big and strong. I will find it, but I am scared." Ben wanted to help the bird be brave, so he hopped around the tree, looking for the hole.
After a while, Ben found the hole where the bird lived. The bird was so happy and thanked Ben for being so polite and kind. They became good friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She liked to play with her toys in the bathtub. One day, she saw a small bird outside her window. The bird looked sad and could not fly.
Sue wanted to help the bird. She took her toy boat and went to the bathtub. She put the boat in the water and used a cloth to make it clean. The bird looked at the boat and then looked at Sue. It felt better and started to jump and fly around the room.
Sue was happy to see the bird fly. She knew it was available to be her friend. They played together in the bathtub and had lots of fun. From that day on, Sue and the bird were best friends, and they always played together in the bathtub.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly bird named Bob. Bob lived in a big tree near a small house. Every day, he would fly around and talk to his friends.
One day, while Bob was sitting on a branch, he saw a little girl named Sue. Sue was sad because her toy was stuck in a tree. Bob wanted to help Sue.
Bob flew up to the tree and used his beak to grab the toy. Then, he gave it back to Sue. Sue was so happy and gave Bob a big hug. They became best friends and played together all day long.
